content.text:
`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability
  (`execution_env.dart`; `LocalShell`/`LocalExecutionEnv` implement it,
  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and
  the app's `ProjectMountEnv`/`SandboxedExecutionEnv`/
  `PersistentWebExecutionEnv` forward it — the desktop app runs the host
  shell; mobile's `WasiSandboxShell` and web's `MemoryShell` run jobs as
  detached script Futures on job-local interpreter clones via
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/shell_job.dart` — own cwd/vars/capture, shared
  fs). `bash background: true` runs detached with output
  streaming into `.fah/bash_jobs/<id>.log`; `bash_job {status|output|stop}`
  (write tier) manages them. A settle fires `onSettled` on every exit —
  the CLI's terminal bookkeeping (`_onShellJobSettled`: job-board Running
  count, waiting row) hangs off it (issue #562). The model-facing notice
  (steered mid-run or a fresh idle turn; app `sendText` system-notice)
  is skipped when a foreground call consumed the result inline
  (`suppressSettleNotification`). Job logs on disk are NOT secret-redacted.
- `lib/src/tools/availability.dart` + `availability_gate.dart` —
  capability-gated tool availability (issue #19): `resolveToolAvailability`
  merges the `tools:` scope stack (global `~/.fah/config.yaml` < project
  `.fah/config.yaml` < session `.tools/<sessionId>.yaml` < runtime
  `--tools`/`FA_TOOLS`; deepest scope wins per key) over the host's hard
  capability floor — absent tools can never be force-enabled, unknown ids
  warn. The gate applies a resolution to the live registry idempotently
  (hide/restore + prompt rebuild) and tombstones calls to disabled tools.
  CLI surface in `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_tools.dart` (`/tools`, live
  rebuild); docs/tool-availability.md is the user-facing page.
- `lib/src/tools/load_modes.dart` + `discover_tools_tool.dart` — agent
  load modes (issue #680): `--omp` > `FA_AGENT_MODE` > `agent.mode`

  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file

  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.

  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability
  (`execution_env.dart`; `LocalShell`/`LocalExecutionEnv` implement it,
  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and
  the app's `ProjectMountEnv`/`SandboxedExecutionEnv`/
  `PersistentWebExecutionEnv` forward it — the desktop app runs the host
  shell; mobile's `WasiSandboxShell` and web's `MemoryShell` run jobs as
  detached script Futures on job-local interpreter clones via
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/shell_job.dart` — own cwd/vars/capture, shared
  fs). `bash background: true` runs detached with output
  streaming into `.fah/bash_jobs/<id>.log`; `bash_job {status|output|stop}`
  (write tier) manages them. A settle fires `onSettled` on every exit —
  the CLI's terminal bookkeeping (`_onShellJobSettled`: job-board Running
  count, waiting row) hangs off it (issue #562). The model-facing notice
  (steered mid-run or a fresh idle turn; app `sendText` system-notice)
  is skipped when a foreground call consumed the result inline
  (`suppressSettleNotification`). Job logs on disk are NOT secret-redacted.
- `lib/src/tools/availability.dart` + `availability_gate.dart` —
  capability-gated tool availability (issue #19): `resolveToolAvailability`
  merges the `tools:` scope stack (global `~/.fah/config.yaml` < project
  `.fah/config.yaml` < session `.tools/<sessionId>.yaml` < runtime
  `--tools`/`FA_TOOLS`; deepest scope wins per key) over the host's hard
  capability floor — absent tools can never be force-enabled, unknown ids
  warn. The gate applies a resolution to the live registry idempotently
  (hide/restore + prompt rebuild) and tombstones calls to disabled tools.
  CLI surface in `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_tools.dart` (`/tools`, live
  rebuild); docs/tool-availability.md is the user-facing page.
- `lib/src/tools/load_modes.dart` + `discover_tools_tool.dart` — agent
  load modes (issue #680): `--omp` > `FA_AGENT_MODE` > `agent.mode`
  (`default|pi|omp`) pick the tool-LOAD preset — `default` loads every
  enabled tool; `pi` the 4-tool benchmark base (issue #679, discovery
  off); `omp` the essential base with everything else discoverable,
  mounted on demand through the omp-only `discover_tools` meta tool (an
  explicit `tools: {id: on}` is a standing mount). The gate's
  `discoveryEnabled` flag keeps the discoverable tombstone from
  dead-ending on `discover_tools` in modes that don't register it. CLI
  sync + `/settings` switch in `agent_cli_tools.dart`/`settings_flow.dart`;
  user-facing docs: docs/tool-availability.md §Load modes.
- `lib/src/lsp/` — `lsp` tool (diagnostics/definition/references/rename):
  pure-Dart JSON-RPC client over `LspTransport`; `.dart` →

  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.

  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.

- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL

  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.

  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives

- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be

- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:

  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file

  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.

  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.

  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.

  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability
  (`execution_env.dart`; `LocalShell`/`LocalExecutionEnv` implement it,
  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and
  the app's `ProjectMountEnv`/`SandboxedExecutionEnv`/
  `PersistentWebExecutionEnv` forward it — the desktop app runs the host
  shell; mobile's `WasiSandboxShell` and web's `MemoryShell` run jobs as
  detached script Futures on job-local interpreter clones via
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/shell_job.dart` — own cwd/vars/capture, shared
  fs). `bash background: true` runs detached with output
  streaming into `.fah/bash_jobs/<id>.log`; `bash_job {status|output|stop}`
  (write tier) manages them. A settle fires `onSettled` on every exit —
  the CLI's terminal bookkeeping (`_onShellJobSettled`: job-board Running
  count, waiting row) hangs off it (issue #562). The model-facing notice
  (steered mid-run or a fresh idle turn; app `sendText` system-notice)
  is skipped when a foreground call consumed the result inline
  (`suppressSettleNotification`). Job logs on disk are NOT secret-redacted.

  merges the `tools:` scope stack (global `~/.fah/config.yaml` < project
  `.fah/config.yaml` < session `.tools/<sessionId>.yaml` < runtime

`stripToSandboxPath` — pure lexical + symlink resolution. Note: `SandboxHostRoot` imports `dart:io` — used by MemoryShell? No — MemoryShell imports `wasm_shell_builtins.dart` (pure). wasm_shell.dart is mobile-only. OK.

Important subtlety: `stripToSandboxPath` calls `io.Directory(trimmed).resolveSymbolicLinksSync()` for the symlink-variant retry. This means `_toGuestPath` (sync, called during arg rewriting) does a **synchronous filesystem syscall** for every absolute path that doesn't directly match the root — on every command with absolute operands. `resolveSymbolicLinksSync` on a non-existent path throws → caught → null → return null → verbatim. Performance: for absolute host-projection paths that exist, 1-2 syscalls; for paths outside (e.g. `/etc/passwd`), `resolveSymbolicLinksSync` also does work. It's a per-stage cost but small. `_effectiveCwd` also calls this per stage. Pre-existing pattern (effectiveCwd already did this), so not new overhead class. Fine.

Edge: `resolveSymbolicLinksSync` on macOS `/tmp/...` — `/tmp` is a symlink to `/private/tmp`; the sandbox root would resolve to `/private/var/...`, and a path spelled `/tmp/...` matches via the resolved retry. Good.

Security: could a path like `<host>/../<host2>/secret` strip? `<host>/../x` — `_stripMatched` — pathKey startsWith `<hostKey>/` → cut → `/../x` → normalizeLexicalPath → `/x`. Stays in guest namespace. Guest confined by WASI preopen. No host escape. Good.

What about the ROOT itself being `/`? If sandboxHostPath is `/` (unrealistic), rootKey == '/' → every absolute path maps. Edge case, unrealistic.

Now — the interesting security/correctness question: **`_toGuestPath` maps ANY path under the host root, including paths the agent should perhaps not see?** No — the sandbox host dir IS the sandbox; mapping into it is the intent.

Another: `write`/`edit` tools (lines 1735-1753) — `_hostFile(_resolveSandboxPath(path, _currentDir))`. Previously `_resolveSandboxPath` on an absolute HOST path returned the host path verbatim (normalized), then `_hostFile` — wait, `_hostFile` does `io.File('$host/$stripped')` — for an already-host path this would create a nested mirror! But `_hostPath` has the idempotence check (`contains` → return as-is); `_hostFile` does NOT have that check!

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability

  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and

  detached script Futures on job-local interpreter clones via
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/shell_job.dart` — own cwd/vars/capture, shared
  fs). `bash background: true` runs detached with output
  streaming into `.fah/bash_jobs/<id>.log`; `bash_job {status|output|stop}`
  (write tier) manages them. A settle fires `onSettled` on every exit —
  the CLI's terminal bookkeeping (`_onShellJobSettled`: job-board Running
  count, waiting row) hangs off it (issue #562). The model-facing notice

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.

  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.

  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.

  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.

  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side

  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.

  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.

  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be

blocks.text:
Now I understand the script runner. Key facts:

1. `runShellScriptNodes` tracks `exitCode` for `&&`/`||` separately from `_lastExitCode`/`_lastStageExitCode`. Both are updated on each pipeline run. Consistent.

2. **Assignment-only statement (`A=1`)**: `_runAssignment` returns `Ok(0)` but does NOT update `_lastExitCode` (MemoryShell) or `_lastStageExitCode` (WASI shell). This is the documented divergence. POSIX: `A=1; echo $?` → 0. Here: keeps previous. Documented in code comment + PR description. OK — subset divergence, acknowledged.

Wait — actually there's an inconsistency in the divergence handling: in `runShellScriptNodes`, `exitCode = result.valueOrNull!` IS updated to 0 for assignments (affects `&&`/`||`), but `$?` doesn't change. So `false && echo hi; echo rc=$?` — hmm: `false` → exitCode=1; `&& echo hi` skipped; `echo rc=$?` — `_lastExitCode` = 1 from false → prints rc=1. POSIX: after `false && echo hi`, `$?` = 1. ✓.

`A=1 && echo hi; echo rc=$?` — assignment node → runner exitCode=0 → echo runs → `_lastExitCode` = 0. ✓.

`A=1; echo rc=$?` — assignment → exitCode 0, `_lastExitCode` unchanged (e.g. 1 from prior false) → prints rc=1, POSIX says rc=0. Documented divergence. Fine.

3. Command substitution: `x=$(false)` — `_isAssignment` checks every word is `NAME=...` — `x=$(false)` → yes → `_runAssignment` expands value via expandShellWord → substitution runs `false` → sets `_lastStageExitCode`/`_lastExitCode` to 1 → then assignment returns Ok(0) without touching `_lastExitCode` → so after `x=$(false); echo $?` → 1. POSIX: also 1 (assignment with command substitution keeps substitution's status). ✓ Correct by accident!

4. `for` loops: `runner.setVariable(node.variable, word)` — sets loop var. `_lastExitCode` updated by body runs. ✓.

5. `if` conditions update `_lastExitCode` via their pipeline runs. ✓ POSIX-consistent.

Now — a potential gap in the WASI shell: `_runPipeline` sets `_lastStageExitCode` per stage; but `_runPipelineStage` — what if `_runCommand` returns a builtin result built via `_runBuiltin`? All covered (result.valueOrNull). What if `expansion.isErr` → Err propagates; `_lastStageExitCode` unchanged (stale). POSIX would... edge case, parse/expansion failures. Negligible.

What about `exec()` returning Err for parse error — `$?` stale — but the caller gets Err, no script continues. OK.

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability
  (`execution_env.dart`; `LocalShell`/`LocalExecutionEnv` implement it,
  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and
  the app's `ProjectMountEnv`/`SandboxedExecutionEnv`/
  `PersistentWebExecutionEnv` forward it — the desktop app runs the host
  shell; mobile's `WasiSandboxShell` and web's `MemoryShell` run jobs as
  detached script Futures on job-local interpreter clones via
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/shell_job.dart` — own cwd/vars/capture, shared
  fs). `bash background: true` runs detached with output
  streaming into `.fah/bash_jobs/<id>.log`; `bash_job {status|output|stop}`
  (write tier) manages them. A settle fires `onSettled` on every exit —
  the CLI's terminal bookkeeping (`_onShellJobSettled`: job-board Running
  count, waiting row) hangs off it (issue #562). The model-facing notice
  (steered mid-run or a fresh idle turn; app `sendText` system-notice)
  is skipped when a foreground call consumed the result inline
  (`suppressSettleNotification`). Job logs on disk are NOT secret-redacted.
- `lib/src/tools/availability.dart` + `availability_gate.dart` —
  capability-gated tool availability (issue #19): `resolveToolAvailability`
  merges the `tools:` scope stack (global `~/.fah/config.yaml` < project
  `.fah/config.yaml` < session `.tools/<sessionId>.yaml` < runtime
  `--tools`/`FA_TOOLS`; deepest scope wins per key) over the host's hard
  capability floor — absent tools can never be force-enabled, unknown ids
  warn. The gate applies a resolution to the live registry idempotently

  CLI surface in `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_tools.dart` (`/tools`, live

  (`default|pi|omp`) pick the tool-LOAD preset — `default` loads every
  enabled tool; `pi` the 4-tool benchmark base (issue #679, discovery
  off); `omp` the essential base with everything else discoverable,
  mounted on demand through the omp-only `discover_tools` meta tool (an

  user-facing docs: docs/tool-availability.md §Load modes.

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability
  (`execution_env.dart`; `LocalShell`/`LocalExecutionEnv` implement it,
  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and

  `PersistentWebExecutionEnv` forward it — the desktop app runs the host

  detached script Futures on job-local interpreter clones via
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/shell_job.dart` — own cwd/vars/capture, shared
  fs). `bash background: true` runs detached with output
  streaming into `.fah/bash_jobs/<id>.log`; `bash_job {status|output|stop}`
  (write tier) manages them. A settle fires `onSettled` on every exit —
  the CLI's terminal bookkeeping (`_onShellJobSettled`: job-board Running
  count, waiting row) hangs off it (issue #562). The model-facing notice

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability
  (`execution_env.dart`; `LocalShell`/`LocalExecutionEnv` implement it,
  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and
  the app's `ProjectMountEnv`/`SandboxedExecutionEnv`/
  `PersistentWebExecutionEnv` forward it — the desktop app runs the host
  shell; mobile's `WasiSandboxShell` and web's `MemoryShell` run jobs as
  detached script Futures on job-local interpreter clones via
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/shell_job.dart` — own cwd/vars/capture, shared
  fs). `bash background: true` runs detached with output
  streaming into `.fah/bash_jobs/<id>.log`; `bash_job {status|output|stop}`
  (write tier) manages them. A settle fires `onSettled` on every exit —
  the CLI's terminal bookkeeping (`_onShellJobSettled`: job-board Running
  count, waiting row) hangs off it (issue #562). The model-facing notice
  (steered mid-run or a fresh idle turn; app `sendText` system-notice)
  is skipped when a foreground call consumed the result inline
  (`suppressSettleNotification`). Job logs on disk are NOT secret-redacted.
- `lib/src/tools/availability.dart` + `availability_gate.dart` —
  capability-gated tool availability (issue #19): `resolveToolAvailability`
  merges the `tools:` scope stack (global `~/.fah/config.yaml` < project
  `.fah/config.yaml` < session `.tools/<sessionId>.yaml` < runtime
  `--tools`/`FA_TOOLS`; deepest scope wins per key) over the host's hard
  capability floor — absent tools can never be force-enabled, unknown ids
  warn. The gate applies a resolution to the live registry idempotently
  (hide/restore + prompt rebuild) and tombstones calls to disabled tools.
  CLI surface in `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_tools.dart` (`/tools`, live
  rebuild); docs/tool-availability.md is the user-facing page.
- `lib/src/tools/load_modes.dart` + `discover_tools_tool.dart` — agent
  load modes (issue #680): `--omp` > `FA_AGENT_MODE` > `agent.mode`
  (`default|pi|omp`) pick the tool-LOAD preset — `default` loads every
  enabled tool; `pi` the 4-tool benchmark base (issue #679, discovery
  off); `omp` the essential base with everything else discoverable,
  mounted on demand through the omp-only `discover_tools` meta tool (an
  explicit `tools: {id: on}` is a standing mount). The gate's

  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)

Let me look at the full `_pathPositionalCommands` set and think about which commands now treat absolute args differently: previously verbatim, now `_resolveSandboxPath` → `_normalizeSandboxPath(_toGuestPath(path))`.

Potential behavior changes:
1. Host-projection absolute paths → mapped to guest — intended fix.
2. Guest-absolute paths → `stripToSandboxPath` returns null (outside host root) → verbatim → normalized. Same as before. ✓
3. What about a path that happens to be inside the host root TEXTUALLY but is meant as guest path? `_hostPath` had this ambiguity note: "a sandbox-virtual path that textually begins with the host root is treated as already mapped; both readings stay inside the sandbox." Same accepted trade-off.

4. **Normalization side effect**: `_normalizeSandboxPath` collapses `..` lexically. Previously absolute args were passed verbatim WITHOUT normalization. So `cat /a/../b` — old: guest got `/a/../b` (guest kernel resolves); new: lexically normalized `/b`. Equivalent for sane paths; differs for symlinked dirs (lexical `..` vs physical). Edge — WASI preopen at `/`, symlink `..` handling — a lexical collapse could change meaning if `/a` is a symlink. In the sandbox this is unlikely to matter. Not worth flagging beyond a nit? It's a real (if exotic) behavior change: `cat /dir/../file` where `dir` is a symlink — lexical normalization resolves against the wrong physical parent. Extremely edge-case in this sandbox. I'll mention as SUGGESTION-level at most. Hmm, actually since normalizeLexicalPath was ALREADY applied to relative resolutions (and to cwd), applying it to absolute operands is consistent. Fine — not a real finding, skip or make it a nit... I'll leave it out; too exotic, and consistent with existing conventions.

5. Glob patterns with absolute paths: e.g. `ls /tmp/*.py` — old: verbatim (guest globs). New: `_toGuestPath('/tmp/*.py')` — strip fails (unless under host root!) — if the string starts with the host root (it doesn't for /tmp) → verbatim. But `ls <host>/*.py`? stripToSandboxPath does lexical prefix match → `<host>/*.py` starts with `<host>/` → strips → `/*.py`. OK guest globs `/*.py` — right thing.

But careful — `find <host> -name '*.py'`: `find` in `_pathPositionalCommands`? Probably yes. Strips to `/`. Good.

What about wildcard args to non-path-positional commands like `rg pattern <host>/**`? `_rewriteExistingPath` — `io.FileSystemEntity.typeSync(_hostPath(resolved))` — for a glob, notFound → stays verbatim (host form!) → rg gets host-abs → ENOENT. Hmm: rg on a nonexistent glob path — old behavior also verbatim host-abs (which failed ENOENT inside guest). Same failure class. Fine.

6. What about commands where absolute operands are NOT paths at all? `_pathPositionalCommands` — all path-ish. For mixed commands the existence heuristic gates rewriting. `cut -d/ -f1`? `cut` args like `-d/` start with `-` → flag, skipped. `cut -f2 /etc/passwd`... path-positional → resolved. OK.

What about `basename /a/b/c`? Resolves: `_toGuestPath('/a/b/c')` — outside host root → verbatim → normalize. Guest basename works. If host-projection → strips. ✓.

`expr` / `tr`? Not path commands. `expr / 1`? weird, skip.

`date +%Y`? starts with `+`, not `/`. `date -d @123`? flag. OK.

  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.

- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`

blocks.text:
`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability
  (`execution_env.dart`; `LocalShell`/`LocalExecutionEnv` implement it,
  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and
  the app's `ProjectMountEnv`/`SandboxedExecutionEnv`/

Working tree is clean (`.env` removed, no stray changes).

Now let me consolidate my findings. Let me do the final exhaustive pass over the changed files to make sure I haven't missed anything.

## Findings inventory

### Verified-good (no findings)
1. **AC1 fix** (`_resolveSandboxPath`/`_toGuestPath`): correct, uses shared `SandboxHostRoot` convention, hardened against trailing sep/symlink/case. Tests pin guest-boundary argv with iOS-shaped host path. Also fixes `test -f <host-abs>` and the `write`/`edit`/`stat` `_hostFile(_resolveSandboxPath(...))` double-prefix mirror (bonus).
2. **AC2 fix** (`$?`): expander handles `$?` and `${?}`; both shells publish `'?'` after spreads; `export ?=1` blocked by `exportEnvVarName`; `env` filtered in both shells; WASI spawn env filters non-identifier names. Tests cover expansion forms, quoting, persistence, and no-leak.
3. **AC3 half-fix** (127 loud unknown commands): guard placed in `_runCommand` after the builtin dispatch; all `_runStage` callers guarded; consistent with `which`/`command -v` and the registry doc ("hitting 127" is the documented design). `echo rc=$?` after unknown → 127 ✓.
4. Web-build safety: `wasm_shell_builtins.dart` is pure Dart — MemoryShell's new import doesn't pull WASM/FFI into the web build. ✓ (I verified imports: dart:convert, shell_parser, path).
5. Tests: 146/146 + memory/builtins 152/152 pass on Flutter 3.47.6; analyzer clean on touched files; format applied (dart 3.13 formatting style visible in diff).
6. Security: no injection/secret issues; path mapping keeps everything inside the guest preopen; `_stripMatched` lexical prefix cut can't escape (normalize collapses `..` inside guest namespace only).

### Candidate findings (severity review)

**A. `applyExportArgs` bare-name branch still accepts invalid identifiers** (`wasm_shell_builtins.dart`):
```dart
} else {
  env.putIfAbsent(arg, () => '');
}
```
`export ?` or `export 1foo` inserts `'?'`/`'1foo'` into `_shellEnv`. In the wasm shell, `formatExportListings` (no-arg `export` listing) does NOT filter `?`, so `export ?; export` prints `declare -x ?=""`, while MemoryShell's `_export` filters `?`. Also `?` then sits in `_shellEnv` forever (harmless for expansion since `_effectiveEnv` overrides, and spawn filters it). Pre-existing shape but now inconsistent with the new "invalid names are ignored" policy and with MemoryShell's filtering. → SUGGESTION.

**B. `export NAME=value` with invalid NAME is silently ignored** — bash prints `bash: export: '1=x': not a valid identifier` and sets exit status 1. Both shells now silently `continue` and return exit 0. Silent-swallow of user error; also `$?` after a failed export reports 0. The PR's own theme is "fail loudly". → SUGGESTION (or IMPORTANT?). It's a divergence from bash in error reporting, not correctness of the fix. I'd rate SUGGESTION — the shells are documented subsets. Hmm — "Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed?" from the checklist. It IS a silent swallow introduced by this PR. But it only affects invalid-identifier exports, an edge case in a documented subset shell. I'll flag as SUGGESTION with a clear rationale. Actually, let me reconsider: the guard's purpose is to prevent shadowing `?`. Silently ignoring `export 1foo=x` also changes prior behavior (previously it stored it). Anyone relying on storing arbitrary keys via export would see data loss — but such keys were then filtered from WASI spawn env anyway (invalid identifiers can't be passed to WASI), so storing them was only useful for `$VAR` expansion within the shell... and the expander only recognizes identifier-starting names, so `$1foo` never expanded anyway. Net: the stored value was unreachable except via `env`/`export` listing. So silently dropping is near-harmless. SUGGESTION it is.

**C. MemoryShell `_effectiveEnv` publishes `'?'` to consumers that don't filter it** — in MemoryShell, `_effectiveEnv` is passed to `web_git.run(env:)` (only reads GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/EMAIL — harmless) and used for expansion/env builtin (filtered). Not passed to interpreters. So no real issue. Drop this.

Wait — one more consumer: `_forJob` clone — `clone._shellEnv.addAll(_shellEnv)` — can `_shellEnv` ever contain `?` in MemoryShell? Via `export ?` bare → putIfAbsent → yes! `_shellEnv['?'] = ''` — then `export` listing filters it ✓, but the clone copies it — harmless. And `_effectiveEnv` spreads `_shellEnv` then overrides `?` ✓. OK no issue.

**D. `$?` in `for` loop variable/word context, arithmetic `$((...))`** — not supported forms; `$((...))` — is arithmetic supported at all? `_expandPlainAt` doesn't handle `((`. Pre-existing. Not a finding.

**E. Assignment-only statement doesn't reset `$?`** — documented divergence (code comment + PR description + ticket). Not a finding; noted as known limitation. The reviewer guideline says verify ACs: AC2 path (`cmd; echo rc=$?`) is exact. Fine.

**F. `_rewriteExistingPath` existence check on EVERY absolute arg of mixed commands** — `io.FileSystemEntity.typeSync` is a sync FS syscall per arg per stage. Pre-existing for relative args of mixed commands (the heuristic existed); now absolute args also traverse it. On iOS this is local disk — cheap. And `stripToSandboxPath` may do `resolveSymbolicLinksSync` for absolute paths outside the root (one syscall, throws for nonexistent → caught). Per-stage overhead is bounded and small; `_effectiveCwd` already did exactly this. → Not a finding, maybe a SUGGESTION-level note about sync I/O in the arg-rewrite hot path? It's pre-existing pattern (gh-1274 established it), the PR merely extends coverage. I'll skip it — flagging pre-existing accepted patterns as new findings would be noise. Actually — hmm, one *new* sync-FS call: `_toGuestPath` on absolute paths — for a path OUTSIDE the host root (e.g. `cat /etc/passwd`), `stripToSandboxPath` does `io.Directory(trimmed).resolveSymbolicLinksSync()` which throws → caught → null. An exception-per-call for every outside-root absolute operand. Cheap but it's try/catch control flow as normal path. `typeSync` also existed. I'll leave it as a nit inside a suggestion only if I have room... Better: keep the review focused. Skip.

**G. `formatExportListings` doesn't filter `?`** (wasm shell) — folded into finding A (same root: bare-name branch + unfiltered listing). One comment file can cover both: "export listing / bare-name branch can still materialize `?` in the wasm shell while MemoryShell filters it — align".

Wait, actually let me re-check: can `?` get into wasm `_shellEnv`? Paths: (1) `export ?=1` → blocked ✓; (2) `export ?` bare → putIfAbsent('?', '') → IN; (3) `?=1` assignment → parser `_isAssignmentWord('?')` → `eq <= 0` → false → not an assignment → treated as command `?=1` → 127 command not found (bash-consistent) ✓; (4) `unset ?` → removes. So only path (2). And the `env` builtin filters `?` so `env` won't show it; only bare `export` listing would. Narrow but real inconsistency. SUGGESTION.

**H. `_maybeRewritePath` for quoted args**: `_isPathArg` doesn't check quoting — a quoted absolute arg like `cat "/var/mobile/.../hello.py"` — parser strips quotes? The stage argv after parsing has quotes removed (shell_parser produces argv words; `isQuoted` flag exists on Stage for expansion but argv words are unquoted). So `cat "<host>/hello.py"` → word `<host>/hello.py` → rewritten ✓ good.

But `echo "hello > file"`? Not path commands. OK.

`lib/src/cli/trajectory_tui.dart` — the read-only REPL family
  `/trajectory [view|cost|tail|inspect <n>]` (bare = `view`, capped at 200
  rows; `tail` follows the live session every 500ms) and the headless
  `fa trajectory <view|tail|cost|inspect> [sessionId] [--json] [--at N]`
  subcommand (`--at N` replays the snapshot as it stood at record N, view
  only). Session resolution: exact id > session-name match > most recent.
  Rendering is pure Dart in `trajectory_tui.dart` (no `dart:io`), shared by
  both entries; `bin/fah.dart` routes the subcommand.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (issue #24): ten pure layer
  functions (registered/path/vendor/prefix/pem/asn1/connection/context/
  entropy/pii) merged priority-first into `RedactionPipeline.scan/redact`
  with `[REDACTED:<kind>]` idempotent markers, allowlist + data-URL
  pass-through, live-mutable `RedactionConfig`, and `RedactionStats`
  (per layer + per tool). `redaction_hooks.dart` attaches it to the agent:
  afterToolCall masks tool results BEFORE session persist, transformContext
  masks the outgoing context, beforeToolCall denies credential-file
  read/bash in `blockMode`, `redactPrompt` masks user input — write-side
  tools (`write`/`edit`/`checkpoint`/MCP write-ish) are never filtered
  (AC7). Config: `redact:` in `~/.fah/config.yaml` or project
  `.fah/config.yaml` (tolerant parse). CLI `/redact`; docs/redaction.md.
- `lib/src/hashline/` — hashline patch language: `[path#TAG]` headers
  (4-hex xxHash32 of whole file), `SWAP`/`DEL`/`INS.*` ops, all-or-nothing
  `HashlinePatcher`, stale tags reject before any write. Wired in
  `builtin_tools.dart`: `edit` takes `patch`, `read` takes `hashline` flag.
- `lib/src/tools/read_selector.dart` — `read` trailing selectors:
  `:N`/`:A-B`/`:A+C` (`..` alias), comma multi-ranges, `:raw`. A literal
  file named `x:1-2` wins over the selector. `offset`/`limit` must not be
  combined with a selector.
- `lib/src/tools/archive_reader.dart` — `read` inside archives
  (`a.zip:inner/entry`, `.tar`, `.tgz`), 256 MiB cap.
- `lib/src/tools/sqlite/` — `read` SQLite targets (`db.sqlite`,
  `:table[:key][?params]`, `?q=SELECT`). FFI engine (`package:sqlite3`)
  exported only from `lib/io.dart`, passed via `builtinTools(env, sqlite:)`;
  without it a clean "not supported" note.
- `lib/src/tools/shell_jobs.dart` — background shell jobs:
  `ShellJobRegistry` over the `BackgroundShell` capability
  (`execution_env.dart`; `LocalShell`/`LocalExecutionEnv` implement it,
  `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`/`SecretsExecutionEnv`/`MemoryExecutionEnv` and
  the app's `ProjectMountEnv`/`SandboxedExecutionEnv`/
  `PersistentWebExecutionEnv` forward it — the desktop app runs the host
  shell; mobile's `WasiSandboxShell` and web's `MemoryShell` run jobs as
  detached script Futures on job-local interpreter clones via
  `flutter_app/lib/sandbox/shell_job.dart` — own cwd/vars/capture, shared
  fs). `bash background: true` runs detached with output
  streaming into `.fah/bash_jobs/<id>.log`; `bash_job {status|output|stop}`
  (write tier) manages them. A settle fires `onSettled` on every exit —
  the CLI's terminal bookkeeping (`_onShellJobSettled`: job-board Running
  count, waiting row) hangs off it (issue #562). The model-facing notice
  (steered mid-run or a fresh idle turn; app `sendText` system-notice)
  is skipped when a foreground call consumed the result inline
  (`suppressSettleNotification`). Job logs on disk are NOT secret-redacted.
- `lib/src/tools/availability.dart` + `availability_gate.dart` —
  capability-gated tool availability (issue #19): `resolveToolAvailability`
  merges the `tools:` scope stack (global `~/.fah/config.yaml` < project
  `.fah/config.yaml` < session `.tools/<sessionId>.yaml` < runtime
  `--tools`/`FA_TOOLS`; deepest scope wins per key) over the host's hard
  capability floor — absent tools can never be force-enabled, unknown ids
  warn. The gate applies a resolution to the live registry idempotently
  (hide/restore + prompt rebuild) and tombstones calls to disabled tools.
  CLI surface in `lib/src/cli/agent_cli_tools.dart` (`/tools`, live
  rebuild); docs/tool-availability.md is the user-facing page.
- `lib/src/tools/load_modes.dart` + `discover_tools_tool.dart` — agent
  load modes (issue #680): `--omp` > `FA_AGENT_MODE` > `agent.mode`
  (`default|pi|omp`) pick the tool-LOAD preset — `default` loads every
  enabled tool; `pi` the 4-tool benchmark base (issue #679, discovery
  off); `omp` the essential base with everything else discoverable,
  mounted on demand through the omp-only `discover_tools` meta tool (an
  explicit `tools: {id: on}` is a standing mount). The gate's
  `discoveryEnabled` flag keeps the discoverable tombstone from
  dead-ending on `discover_tools` in modes that don't register it. CLI
  sync + `/settings` switch in `agent_cli_tools.dart`/`settings_flow.dart`;
  user-facing docs: docs/tool-availability.md §Load modes.
- `lib/src/lsp/` — `lsp` tool (diagnostics/definition/references/rename):
  pure-Dart JSON-RPC client over `LspTransport`; `.dart` →
  `dart language-server --protocol=lsp`, projects merge `.fah/lsp.json`;

Tests pin guest-boundary argv with iOS-shaped host path. Also fixes `test -f <host-abs>` and the `write`/`edit`/`stat` `_hostFile(_resolveSandboxPath(...))` double-prefix mirror (bonus).
2. **AC2 fix** (`$?`): expander handles `$?` and `${?}`; both shells publish `'?'` after spreads; `export ?=1` blocked by `exportEnvVarName`; `env` filtered in both shells; WASI spawn env filters non-identifier names. Tests cover expansion forms, quoting, persistence, and no-leak.
3. **AC3 half-fix** (127 loud unknown commands): guard placed in `_runCommand` after the builtin dispatch; all `_runStage` callers guarded; consistent with `which`/`command -v` and the registry doc ("hitting 127" is the documented design). `echo rc=$?` after unknown → 127 ✓.
4. Web-build safety: `wasm_shell_builtins.dart` is pure Dart — MemoryShell's new import doesn't pull WASM/FFI into the web build. ✓ (I verified imports: dart:convert, shell_parser, path).
5. Tests: 146/146 + memory/builtins 152/152 pass on Flutter 3.47.6; analyzer clean on touched files; format applied (dart 3.13 formatting style visible in diff).
6. Security: no injection/secret issues; path mapping keeps everything inside the guest preopen; `_stripMatched` lexical prefix cut can't escape (normalize collapses `..` inside guest namespace only).

### Candidate findings (severity review)

**A. `applyExportArgs` bare-name branch still accepts invalid identifiers** (`wasm_shell_builtins.dart`):
```dart
} else {
  env.putIfAbsent(arg, () => '');
}
```
`export ?` or `export 1foo` inserts `'?'`/`'1foo'` into `_shellEnv`. In the wasm shell, `formatExportListings` (no-arg `export` listing) does NOT filter `?`, so `export ?; export` prints `declare -x ?=""`, while MemoryShell's `_export` filters `?`. Also `?` then sits in `_shellEnv` forever (harmless for expansion since `_effectiveEnv` overrides, and spawn filters it). Pre-existing shape but now inconsistent with the new "invalid names are ignored" policy and with MemoryShell's filtering. → SUGGESTION.

**B. `export NAME=value` with invalid NAME is silently ignored** — bash prints `bash: export: '1=x': not a valid identifier` and sets exit status 1. Both shells now silently `continue` and return exit 0. Silent-swallow of user error; also `$?` after a failed export reports 0. The PR's own theme is "fail loudly". → SUGGESTION (or IMPORTANT?). It's a divergence from bash in error reporting, not correctness of the fix. I'd rate SUGGESTION — the shells are documented subsets. Hmm — "Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed?" from the checklist. It IS a silent swallow introduced by this PR. But it only affects invalid-identifier exports, an edge case in a documented subset shell. I'll flag as SUGGESTION with a clear rationale. Actually, let me reconsider: the guard's purpose is to prevent shadowing `?`. Silently ignoring `export 1foo=x` also changes prior behavior (previously it stored it). Anyone relying on storing arbitrary keys via export would see data loss — but such keys were then filtered from WASI spawn env anyway (invalid identifiers can't be passed to WASI), so storing them was only useful for `$VAR` expansion within the shell... and the expander only recognizes identifier-starting names, so `$1foo` never expanded anyway. Net: the stored value was unreachable except via `env`/`export` listing. So silently dropping is near-harmless. SUGGESTION it is.

**C. MemoryShell `_effectiveEnv` publishes `'?'` to consumers that don't filter it** — in MemoryShell, `_effectiveEnv` is passed to `web_git.run(env:)` (only reads GIT_AUTHOR_NAME/EMAIL — harmless) and used for expansion/env builtin (filtered). Not passed to interpreters. So no real issue. Drop this.

Wait — one more consumer: `_forJob` clone — `clone._shellEnv.addAll(_shellEnv)` — can `_shellEnv` ever contain `?` in MemoryShell? Via `export ?` bare → putIfAbsent → yes! `_shellEnv['?'] = ''` — then `export` listing filters it ✓, but the clone copies it — harmless. And `_effectiveEnv` spreads `_shellEnv` then overrides `?` ✓. OK no issue.

**D. `$?` in `for` loop variable/word context, arithmetic `$((...))`** — not supported forms; `$((...))` — is arithmetic supported at all? `_expandPlainAt` doesn't handle `((`. Pre-existing. Not a finding.

**E. Assignment-only statement doesn't reset `$?`** — documented divergence (code comment + PR description + ticket). Not a finding; noted as known limitation. The reviewer guideline says verify ACs: AC2 path (`cmd; echo rc=$?`) is exact. Fine.

**F. `_rewriteExistingPath` existence check on EVERY absolute arg of mixed commands** — `io.FileSystemEntity.typeSync` is a sync FS syscall per arg per stage. Pre-existing for relative args of mixed commands (the heuristic existed); now absolute args also traverse it. On iOS this is local disk — cheap. And `stripToSandboxPath` may do `resolveSymbolicLinksSync` for absolute paths outside the root (one syscall, throws for nonexistent → caught). Per-stage overhead is bounded and small; `_effectiveCwd` already did exactly this. → Not a finding, maybe a SUGGESTION-level note about sync I/O in the arg-rewrite hot path? It's pre-existing pattern (gh-1274 established it), the PR merely extends coverage. I'll skip it — flagging pre-existing accepted patterns as new findings would be noise. Actually — hmm, one *new* sync-FS call: `_toGuestPath` on absolute paths — for a path OUTSIDE the host root (e.g. `cat /etc/passwd`), `stripToSandboxPath` does `io.Directory(trimmed).resolveSymbolicLinksSync()` which throws → caught → null. An exception-per-call for every outside-root absolute operand. Cheap but it's try/catch control flow as normal path. `typeSync` also existed. I'll leave it as a nit inside a suggestion only if I have room... Better: keep the review focused. Skip.

**G. `formatExportListings` doesn't filter `?`** (wasm shell) — folded into finding A (same root: bare-name branch + unfiltered listing). One comment file can cover both: "export listing / bare-name branch can still materialize `?` in the wasm shell while MemoryShell filters it — align".

Wait, actually let me re-check: can `?` get into wasm `_shellEnv`? Paths: (1) `export ?=1` → blocked ✓; (2) `export ?` bare → putIfAbsent('?', '') → IN; (3) `?=1` assignment → parser `_isAssignmentWord('?')` → `eq <= 0` → false → not an assignment → treated as command `?=1` → 127 command not found (bash-consistent) ✓; (4) `unset ?` → removes. So only path (2). And the `env` builtin filters `?` so `env` won't show it; only bare `export` listing would. Narrow but real inconsistency. SUGGESTION.

**H. `_maybeRewritePath` for quoted args**: `_isPathArg` doesn't check quoting — a quoted absolute arg like `cat "/var/mobile/.../hello.py"` — parser strips quotes? The stage argv after parsing has quotes removed (shell_parser produces argv words; `isQuoted` flag exists on Stage for expansion but argv words are unquoted). So `cat "<host>/hello.py"` → word `<host>/hello.py` → rewritten ✓ good.

But `echo "hello > file"`? Not path commands. OK.

**I. `printf '%s' /abs`** — printf not path-positional; heuristic: `/abs` outside root, doesn't exist → verbatim ✓. `<host>/x` exists → rewritten → printf prints guest path — behavior change vs before (before: verbatim). Printing a rewritten path through printf is arguably wrong (echo/printf operands are data, not paths) — but `echo`/`printf` are NOT in `_pathPositionalCommands`... wait, `_rewriteRelativePath` — for non-path-positional commands it goes to `_rewriteExistingPath` which rewrites ANY arg (positional index untracked — flags were filtered by `_isPathArg` upstream in `_rewritePositionalArgs`) that textually names an existing file.
